capabilities: Adjust line height, paragraph spacing, and list spacing for body text, lists, and headings
Style callouts, blockquotes, tables, images, and code blocks with independent settings
Configure Live Preview and reading modes separately with per-module toggles
Control sizing and spacing of Mermaid diagrams by aspect ratio
Export and import settings as JSON for backup
disambiguation: Not a workspace or pane layout manager; it adjusts typography, spacing, and element styling inside notes.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the landscape minimum-width Mermaid setting is disabled on Obsidian 1.15+ because core now supports responsive diagrams. Appearance also depends on the user's theme, CSS snippets, and other layout plugins.
problem: Obsidian exposes no built-in settings for fine-grained layout tweaks like list item spacing, callout padding, or per-heading spacing, so users normally have to write CSS snippets.
summary: Layout and typography controls that adjust line height, spacing, and element appearance in editing and reading views without writing CSS.
